title: Ionescu to Stewart Sinks the No. 1 Lynx in Game 1
description: Sabrina Ionescu assisted Breanna Stewart five times as the No. 8 Liberty beat the No. 1 Lynx 91-75. Stewart finished with 34 points and 12 rebounds.
imageAlt: Sabrina Ionescu of the New York Liberty

title: This Is the Olympics of the WNBA
description: The league pauses as Team USA heads to Berlin with Caitlin Clark, Angel Reese, Paige Bueckers, A'ja Wilson and a roster carrying 58 combined WNBA All-Star selections.
